run_update_data: run the script to update filter location format in all data files within a folder
check_filter_location: check if a dictionary recursively contains a location key under filters
update_filter_location: update a dictionary by moving location from filters to filters.selector.location
review_update_data: review the update_data function that walks a folder and rewrites data files with updated filters
refactor_check_filter_location: refactor the check_filter_location function to use isinstance instead of type comparison
